_doc: AQG WIP recovery hook pair (PreCompact save + SessionStart recover). Opt-in: copy these two hook arrays into ~/.claude/settings.json under existing 'hooks' key. Inline AQG_ROOT check ensures Claude Code keeps working if AQG is uninstalled. CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is forwarded so wip_save/recover can pin to the actual project dir instead of the hook's runtime cwd. POSIX (macOS/Linux) only; Windows 用户请改成 PowerShell 等价命令。

hooks.command: if [ -z "${AQG_ROOT:-}" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; bash "$AQG_ROOT/agent-packs/claude-code/hooks/wip_save.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" || true
if [ -z "${AQG_ROOT:-}" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; bash "$AQG_ROOT/agent-packs/claude-code/hooks/wip_recover.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" || true
